header: Ask us to price it properly
lead: Above fifteen practitioners, or across more than three addresses, the list prices stop being the right answer. Tell us the shape of the organisation and you get a figure in writing rather than a range on a website.
note: We ask for no patient data at any point, and there is nothing to sign to get an offer. If the answer is that the list price is better for you, that is what the offer will say.

steps.title: Tell us four numbers
steps.text: Practitioners, addresses, roughly how many treatments a month, and the system you are coming from.

steps.title: One call, thirty minutes
steps.text: Only if something in your answers needs clarifying. Many offers go out without it.

steps.title: A written offer in three working days
steps.text: Itemised, with the migration and training separated from the running cost.

steps.title: Valid for sixty days
steps.text: Long enough to go through a committee. The price in it does not move while it stands.
